clips.title: The story
paras: At a Venture Company camp in the northern Barrens, a trapped pilot needs an ignition key before their cover fails. The operative hijacked a shredder without its key and needs someone to fetch it from the site supervisor.

A spy sent by Sputtervalve has slipped into a Venture Company shredder at the northern Barrens drilling grounds. The operative means to seize the machine and study how it works. But the steering and movement column stays locked without its ignition key.

A goblin worker has noticed the shredder sitting idle, so the hijacker bluffs that its engine has failed. Trapped beneath the glass canopy with workers nearby, the operative points you toward the central derrick. The supervisor keeps spare ignition keys in the upper control office, the only way out before the bluff fails.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.
We need to get out of here on the double! Go up to the control room at the top of the derrick, the supervisor should have a key for this shredder.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Quick, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing...

Hmm... Rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... Fine arm movement control. Just look at this! I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. I've got to get this back to Ratchet!
